limitations: Publisher labels, not exhaustive independent human reannotation.
Prompt/hash screening does not prove all scene overlap or training-image overlap absent.
Equal-class, equal-shard benchmark sampling does not establish calibration for live-upload prevalence.
Row-group bootstrap addresses collection clusters, not every possible content dependence.
Windows CPU evaluation plus a Linux CPU replay of the same benchmark; no video probability or validation for untested runtimes.
The Linux replay is not additional independent test data and did not pass Windows/Linux numerical equivalence; runtime drift is recorded in the supplemental review.

population.training_overlap_method: Published training protocol and archived 136215 legacy prompt records screened; exact training-image exclusion is not proved.
